arts.ttl: Guardiola reaches Champions League 100-game mark with Man City while Barcelona returns to Chelsea
arts.sum: Guardiola has now doubled his tally of 50 Champions League games coaching Barcelona where he won two titles in four seasons. Pep Guardiola has never coached a European competition game below the Champions League level and on Tuesday leads Manchester City in it for the 100th time.
